itens.t: Federal Reserve Leaves Interest Rates Unchanged Amid Persistent Inflation Concerns
itens.r: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced it is keeping its benchmark interest rate steady as it awaits more economic data. itens.t: Fed holds key interest rate steady; Warsh says inflation 'too high'
itens.r: The U.S. Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark interest rate during Wednesday's meeting. Meanwhile, officials noted that ongoing inflation pressures remain uncomfortably high.
